notes: Triton GEMM kernel. Triton compiles tile-level operations to LLVM IR and emits PTX. It uses software pipelining (multi-buffering) within a single thread group. No warp specialization, no cross-WG signals. All buffers are live concurrently during the mainloop. Output is written to registers then stored to global memory directly (no smem epilogue in typical Triton GEMM).
